info.name: Developer Portfolio API
info.description:
Contact form backend with AI-powered analysis (sentiment, classification, auto-response).

Base URL is stored in the `base_url` collection variable — change it once to point at your environment.

request.description: Happy-path submission. Returns AI sentiment, request type, and auto-generated response.

response.name: 200 OK — message received

request.description: Triggers 422 validation errors for all four fields.

response.name: 422 Unprocessable Entity

request.description: Empty body — all four fields are required.
Triggers negative sentiment classification by the AI.

Returns status of cache, storage, mail, and AI components.
HTTP 200 = all healthy, HTTP 207 = one or more degraded.

response.name: 200 OK — all healthy
207 Multi-Status — degraded (no AI key)

request.description: Reads aggregate counters from storage/app/metrics.json. Updates after every POST /contact.
